requirements.quote: This is invoked when DetectAndRemoveLostPackets deems packets lost.
requirements.condition: DetectAndRemoveLostPackets has deemed one or more packets lost.
requirements.required_behavior: Invoke OnPacketsLost with the packets deemed lost.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not omit loss-processing for packets that DetectAndRemoveLostPackets deems lost.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can cause loss detection to classify packets as lost and observe whether OnPacketsLost processing is entered for those packets.

requirements.condition: OnPacketsLost begins processing a lost-packet batch.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize sent_time_of_last_loss to zero for that invocation.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not carry a sent_time_of_last_loss value over from an earlier invocation.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Repeated calls with different packet batches can verify that the loss-time accumulator starts from zero each time.

requirements.condition: A packet in lost_packets is marked in_flight.
requirements.required_behavior: Subtract that packet's sent_bytes from bytes_in_flight.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not subtract the sent_bytes of a lost packet that is not marked in_flight.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A mixed batch of in-flight and non-in-flight lost packets yields an exact expected change to bytes_in_flight.

requirements.condition: An in-flight packet in lost_packets is processed.
requirements.required_behavior: Update sent_time_of_last_loss to the maximum of its current value and that packet's time_sent.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not let an earlier send time replace a later accumulated send time, and do not include packets outside the in_flight branch.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Supplying in-flight lost packets with distinct send times allows the final accumulator and downstream argument to be checked against their maximum.

requirements.condition: After scanning lost_packets, sent_time_of_last_loss is nonzero, indicating that at least one in-flight packet was lost.
requirements.required_behavior: Invoke OnCongestionEvent with sent_time_of_last_loss after the lost packets have been removed from bytes_in_flight.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not invoke OnCongestionEvent from this branch when sent_time_of_last_loss remains zero.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can vary whether the batch contains in-flight packets and verify both the callback count, its argument, and its ordering after flight accounting.

requirements.condition: No first RTT sample has been obtained, represented by first_rtt_sample equal to zero.
requirements.required_behavior: Return before constructing the persistent-congestion candidate set or testing for persistent congestion.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not declare or apply persistent congestion before an RTT sample exists.
requirements.error_behavior: The specified handling is an early return, not an error.
requirements.why_checkable: A loss batch processed with first_rtt_sample equal to zero can be checked for absence of persistent-congestion evaluation and window reset.

requirements.condition: At least one RTT sample exists and persistent-congestion candidates are being selected from lost_packets.
requirements.required_behavior: Start with an empty pc_lost collection and insert exactly the lost packets whose time_sent is strictly greater than first_rtt_sample.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not include a lost packet whose time_sent is equal to or earlier than first_rtt_sample, and do not retain candidates from a prior invocation.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary-value packets sent before, exactly at, and after first_rtt_sample can verify both fresh initialization and the strict-greater-than filter.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain a larger congestion window after persistent congestion is identified.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A candidate loss sequence that satisfies persistent congestion has a deterministic postcondition for congestion_window.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain the prior congestion recovery start time after persistent congestion is identified.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A persistent-congestion event has a deterministic postcondition for congestion_recovery_start_time independent of the window update.

requirements.quote:
When Initial or Handshake keys are discarded, packets sent in that
   space no longer count toward bytes in flight.
requirements.condition: Initial or Handshake keys are discarded.
requirements.required_behavior: Stop counting packets sent in the corresponding discarded packet number space toward bytes in flight.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave packets from that discarded space counted in bytes_in_flight.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can discard each key type and compare bytes_in_flight before and after accounting for packets in its packet number space.

requirements.quote:
foreach packet in discarded_packets:
       if packet.in_flight
         bytes_in_flight -= size
requirements.condition: RemoveFromBytesInFlight processes a discarded packet that is marked in_flight.
requirements.required_behavior: Subtract that packet's size from bytes_in_flight for every in-flight packet in discarded_packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not subtract a discarded packet that is not marked in_flight.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A discarded-packet set with known sizes and mixed in_flight flags yields an exact expected bytes_in_flight decrement.
